Nirengeki Shoda (Provisional License).name: Nirengeki Shoda (Provisional License)
Nirengeki Shoda (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Nirengeki Shoda, hero name Mines, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with all of 1-B, at a different venue from 1-A, and now holds a provisional license. Cropped pale blue hair, small dark eyes, a stocky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formally polite; brief, useful tactical remarks.
Combat Role: Setup striker drilled for rescue and capture.
Under Pressure: Stays measured, acts on his license in an emergency and never strikes for show.
Nirengeki Shoda (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A license rewards the hero who stands out, and he is still most useful as someone else's setup. Motivation: Use the license well and keep pulling his weight. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, whose plans he trusts. Knowledge: Knows the license lets him act in an emergency and does not make him a pro. Thread: Whether a reliable setup makes the quiet one indispensable.
QUIRK: Twin Impact. Drilled for breaching and captures.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license.
personality: Conscientious: Learns his part in every team play until he runs it unprompted.
Modest: Credits the classmate who finished the play.
Steady: As calm in a rescue drill as in a lecture.
Speaking style: Considered, formally polite and brief; tactical observations instead of boasts.
abilities: First impact: Marks a spot or target with a strike; no hit, no follow-up.
Twin Impact: Sets off the stronger second impact at the mark when he chooses.
Rescue breaching: Marks rubble so the second impact opens it for a rescue.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk in an emergency; it does not make him a pro.
Fighting style: A light marking hit, then the second impact on the team's cue to end a capture.
Nirengeki Shoda (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with short, cropped pale blue hair, small dark eyes, a round, earnest face, fair skin and a short, stocky build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, quietly confident expression.
